title: GoMod
source:
module example.com/demo

go 1.22

// Dependencies
require (
  example.com/alpha v1.2.3
  example.com/beta v2.0.0 // indirect
)
replace example.com/alpha => ../alpha
query_adaptations: Capture names normalized to Runestone conventions.
source_adaptations: Set ts_symbol_metadata[anon_sym_LF].visible to false so Runestone can inspect an opening parenthesis at a group boundary. This hides anonymous newline AST nodes; named nodes, lexing, and parse tables retain the upstream definitions.

additional_cases.source:
module example.com/demo
go 1.22
require example.com/one v1.0.0
exclude (
  example.com/two v2.0.0
)
replace (
  example.com/one => ../one
)
retract (
  v0.1.0
)
